source.excerpt: Shared as a general manager that builds a trades company's back office as a crew.

body:
## What it does

Built for construction and the trades: it spins up dispatch, job booking and scheduling alongside finance and marketing helpers, so the office side of a site business has somewhere to live. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer. It is built as a team of bots rather than a single one, so the roles stay separate.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @HouseHackerJon shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
